_how: Base digests are multi-arch index digests from `docker buildx imagetools inspect TAG --format '{{json .Manifest.Digest}}'` (2026-10-24). To pin, build with --build-arg RUST_IMAGE=rust:1.93.1-slim-trixie@DIGEST and RUNTIME_IMAGE=debian:trixie-20261020-slim@DIGEST. Built images: fill from `docker image inspect IMAGE --format '{{.Id}}'` after each release build on the VPS.
